subject: U6: public/graph.html — grouped workspace picker (optgroup per workspace)
description:
Update the dashboard workspace picker to render U3's grouped /workspaces shape. Sole owner of public/graph.html.

Background: U3 (merged on orch/feature/ws-registry) changed GET /workspaces default to grouped `[{name, repos:[{path,name,current}], current}]`, with `?flat=1` returning the legacy `[{path,name,current}]` shape.

Changes (public/graph.html ~4338, ~4353-4409 — loadWorkspacePicker / resolveExplicitWorkspace / selectWorkspace):

- Simplest correct path during rollout: you MAY keep consuming `GET /workspaces?flat=1` to decouple from the grouped parsing if the grouped render is risky — but PREFERRED is to consume the grouped default and render optgroups (that's the point of this unit). Use your judgment; if you fall back to ?flat=1, say so and explain.
- public/inline.html reads ?workspace= only (a repo path) — no change needed; confirm.

Read the ACTUAL current public/graph.html around those lines first. This is a leaf UI file. Do NOT touch routes/meta.js, daemon.js, or any other file.
